evidence_reviewed.evidence: Central portal for eight brands; paid time-based brand/market licences; business account; direct access to connected OEM systems; no data feed API.
Portal transition and company account requirements reviewed.

Official erWin GTC status 14.08.2026. Section 7.1 reserves publication, reproduction, editing, design and exploitation rights in the workshop information. Section 7.4 grants only a simple non-exclusive right for the user's own use, is non-transferable, and requires protective notices to be retained.

Official erWin use-of-product notice states that dissemination, distribution and reproduction of technical information are prohibited, with limited exceptions for internal-company printouts within the same service number and specified maintenance tables, working hours and measurement protocols. These exceptions do not authorize a pre-populated third-party offline database.

Official GTC section 5.8 limits storage of downloaded service information to a maximum of 24 hours; further storage is permitted only to the extent and duration necessary for statutory retention, documentation or evidentiary obligations.

global_decision: No product data downloaded or imported. The direct erWin portal is paid contractual workshop access; the current GTC status 2026-08-14 grants own-use rights only and prohibits transfer/distribution except narrow internal printout exceptions. This is not a license for a pre-populated third-party offline SQLite database. The separate third-party RMI product licence remains governed by its own contract and explicitly excludes Russia. Do not create accounts, accept paid terms, sign agreements or ingest data without owner approval and confirmed distribution scope.
